channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.description: Severe weather battered the Treasure Coast and Palm Beach County on Friday, leaving one man hospitalized after a lightning strike in Okeechobee County and igniting fires in Port St. Lucie. item.title: Waterspout crosses Indian River Lagoon near Sebastian during Friday storms
item.description: Multiple videos captured a large waterspout passing over the Indian River Lagoon Friday afternoon as severe weather moved through Sebastian.

item.title: Port St. Lucie brush fire contained after lightning strike ignites vegetation
item.description: Lucie County Fire District crews contained a brush fire near the 1900 block of Castinet Lane after a lightning strike ignited vegetation in a nearby lot Friday.

item.title: Fire marshal investigates Port St. Lucie house fire on Bellevue Avenue
item.description: Fire crews responded to an evening house fire at the 900 block of Bellevue Avenue in Port St. Lucie as severe weather brought significant lightning to the area.

item.title: Okeechobee County man airlifted after lightning strike during Friday storms
item.description: Fire rescue crews airlifted a man to the hospital after he was struck by lightning in Okeechobee County as severe weather moved through the area Friday.

item.title: JetBlue cancels Vero Beach to New York JFK route in September
item.description: JetBlue is canceling its flight route between Vero Beach Regional Airport and New York's JFK Airport, with the last flights operating on Sept. 9. item.title: Cyclospora cases confirmed in St. Lucie and Martin counties amid produce outbreaks
item.description: The Florida Department of Health has confirmed five local cases of cyclospora since May, including two in St. Lucie County and one in Martin County, as contaminated produce outbreaks spread across the country.

item.title: Major League Baseball restricts dugout iPad use to prevent artificial intelligence decisions
item.description: MLB made custom tabs on dugout iPads inaccessible to teams starting Wednesday night to prevent use of AI for substitutions, pitch calling, and other in-game decisions.

item.title: Florida Panthers to open 2026-27 season against Stanley Cup champion Carolina Hurricanes
item.description: The Panthers will begin their 2026-27 NHL regular season on the road with four Western Conference games before their home opener at Amerant Bank Arena in October.

item.title: Britain's Josh Kerr breaks 27-year-old mile world record at London Diamond League
item.description: Kerr ran the mile in 3:42.66 on Saturday, breaking Hicham El Guerrouj's previous mark of 3:43.13 set in 1999.

item.title: Argentina rallies past England 2-1 with late goals to advance to World Cup final
item.description: Enzo Fernandez and Lautaro Martinez scored in the final minutes to give Argentina a comeback victory after England led 1-0 going into the 85th minute.

item.title: Flip City gymnasts from Treasure Coast earn top 15 national finish, qualify for Junior Olympics
item.description: Three young gymnasts from Flip City Gym and Cheer came to the sport for different reasons but now compete as one unit on the national stage. item.title: Palm Beach County Food Bank serves 2,500 hot meals daily to children at 35 summer sites
item.description: The Palm Beach County Food Bank in Lake Worth Beach is serving approximately 2,500 hot meals each day to nearly 1,250 children through Florida's Summer BreakSpot program while school is out.

item.title: Martin County faces $2.1 billion transportation funding gap as needs outpace available money
item.description: Martin County is facing a $2.1 billion transportation funding shortfall, and the gap between what the county needs and what it can afford could shape how residents get around for decades.

item.title: Vero Beach lawyer discusses importance of documenting truck accident evidence
item.description: A truck accident lawyer in Vero Beach says documenting evidence at the scene remains one of the most overlooked steps after a collision.
